title: Detailed Mineralogical & Lithological Verification
scientific_rationale: Regional 1:250k–1:5M geologic polygon labels remain coarse proxies requiring XRD/VNIR or thin-section confirmation.
suggested_observation_method: Review higher-resolution geological mapping or obtain field/laboratory confirmation of lithology and dominant mineral phases.

title: Fractional Bare-Ground Vegetation Survey
scientific_rationale: Vegetation cover (wt 15%) was unmeasured in regional screening.
suggested_observation_method: Verify absence of vascular/cryptogamic vegetation cover via high-resolution optical imagery or seasonal ground check.

title: Multi-Spectral Surface Albedo Retrieval
scientific_rationale: Surface albedo (wt 15%) was unmeasured in regional screening.
suggested_observation_method: Acquire cloud-free optical/multispectral satellite reflectance (e.g., Landsat/Sentinel-2) to quantify broadband albedo.

title: Surface Clast & Boulder Hazard Mapping
scientific_rationale: Rock abundance carries 10% mission weight and is unmeasured at regional tier.
related_feature_or_gap: Rock abundance / Terrain roughness (missing data, missing_data)
suggested_observation_method: Obtain higher-resolution imagery or field measurements to assess surface rock abundance (>10 cm clasts) and landing/traverse hazards.

title: Regolith Granulometry & Soil Mechanics
scientific_rationale: Median grain size (wt 10%) requires physical sieving and governs wheel sinkage/ISRU sintering.
related_feature_or_gap: Median regolith grain size (missing data, missing_data)
suggested_observation_method: Collect sedimentological or regolith grain-size measurements and bearing-strength profiles in the field or laboratory.

title: Meter-Scale Topographic Survey
scientific_rationale: Regional 5-point ~445 m gradient misses decimeter–meter scarps and rover roll obstacles.
suggested_observation_method: Acquire higher-resolution topographic data (drone photogrammetry, LiDAR, or <2 m stereo DEM) to validate micro-slopes smoothed by 90 m DEM stencils.

title: Local Microclimate vs. Reanalysis Calibration
scientific_rationale: 50 km MERRA-2 2 m air temperatures omit terrain aspect shading, ground thermal inertia, and cold-air drainage.
suggested_observation_method: Compare local meteorological station or surface skin logger observations against NASA POWER 0.5° × 0.625° climatological estimates.
